answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts 5 POA and must answer a beacon challenge in 60s; a harbor of peers verifies proofs, and anyone silent twice loses the bond. A walnut-sized identity is cheap, but 1,000 fakes must fund 5,000 POA and burn 7,000 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back in three epochs. At dawn the beacon lists survivors, so honest ones keep rewards undiluted.
